properties.rationale: Not a defect: cmp:sanitize was built after the last release cut on 2026-07-25, so "ships in nothing" is simply true and expected of anything newly built. It resolves at the next release, which must list it — the same disposition as cmp:claims earlier the same day, and the AGENTS.md release checklist already says the cut lists everything it actually ships rather than a hand-maintained roll-call. Distinct from the cmp:docs case, which needed a decision because it was a pre-existing deliverable the design had never modelled; this one needs only a release.
